core_obligations: Set up with base change (proof lines 19526-19532): by proper base change in its stalk form, (Rf_*K)_s = R Gamma(X_s, K) and likewise at t, and the problem is to show directly that cosp is an isomorphism.

Reformulate cosp (proof lines 19533-19542): cosp is an isomorphism if and only if the pullback by the closed immersion i, from R Gamma(X x_S Spec(O^sh_{S,s}), Rh_*(K|_{X_t})) to R Gamma(X_s, i^{-1}Rh_*(K|_{X_t})), is an isomorphism in D^+(Ab).

Apply base change to the auxiliary complex (proof lines 19543-19556): that arrow is an instance of proper base change for the proper morphism f' : X x_S Spec(O^sh_{S,s}) -> Spec(O^sh_{S,s}) along the morphism s -> Spec(O^sh_{S,s}) and the complex K' = Rh_*(K|_{X_t}), which is bounded below with torsion cohomology sheaves by the torsion direct image lemma; since Spec(O^sh_{S,s}) is strictly henselian with s over the closed point, source and target are (Rf'_*K')_s and R Gamma(X_s, K') and the stalk form of proper base change applies.

Conclude (proof lines 19557-19560): three of the four arrows in the diagram of the specialization/cospecialization lemma are isomorphisms, hence all four are, and both sp and cosp are isomorphisms as asserted.
proof_roadmap: Identify both sides of the assertion with the cohomology of the geometric fibres by proper base change.
Show cosp is an isomorphism by exhibiting the relevant pullback arrow as an instance of proper base change for the auxiliary torsion complex Rh_*(K|_{X_t}).
Conclude for sp as well from the diagram relating the four maps.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a proper morphism locally acyclic relative to a bounded below torsion complex has isomorphisms of specialization and cospecialization over the strict henselisation (statement lines 19506-19523). The proof (proof lines 19525-19560) identifies the two sides by proper base change, reduces the assertion for cosp to a pullback arrow, recognises that arrow as another instance of proper base change for the auxiliary complex Rh_*(K|_{X_t}) (torsion by the direct image lemma), and concludes for sp from the diagram. H2: one reduction and one further base change application, written out.
